title: 9th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/9/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 4/1/2025 to 6/1/2025).

Written question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to Minister of Islamic Affairs Dr Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed: how many Hajj quota places does the Saudi government give the Maldives each year, is there a rule to ensure quota goes to the most deserving operators, and on what basis is quota set aside for the government, the Hajj Corporation and the Ministry?

Written question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Attorney General Ahmed Usham: what legal advice was given for signing a settlement agreement to compensate Capital Marine and Civil Construction (CMC) after HDC cancelled its Rasmalé reclamation contract and handed the work to another company?

Written question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Homeland Security and Technology Ali Ihusaan: under what rule have three letters gone unanswered for so long, namely GU/2024/0031 (5 Aug 2024, on use of permanent and temporary addresses), GU/2024/0063 (23 Oct 2024, on delayed regulations under the Electronic Transactions Act) and GU/2024/0074 (9 Nov 2024, to Maldives Police Service requesting statistics on tourist accidents and deaths)?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission, under Constitution Article 116(a), of changes to the mandates of three ministries for Parliament's approval is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the names of applicants who responded to the Majlis Secretariat's announcement for the two public members Parliament appoints to the Police Board (Police Service Act, Law No. 34/2020, Article 75(r)) are sent to the relevant standing committee.
Judiciary Committee report on the Bill amending the Courts Act (Law No. 22/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to put written questions on Hajj quotas, the CMC Rasmalé settlement and unanswered ministry letters, send ministry mandate changes and Police Board applicants to committee, and take up the Judiciary Committee's report on the Courts Act amendment.
